firstLoad.note: plan §5.2 first-load line: ≤ 8 MB total, figures ≤ 2.5 MB, chunks + non-default interiors lazy-loaded. Enforced at scene-build time (M4.16), recorded here as the profile's own statement of it.

desktop.how: report only — the desktop budget must never ship (SE-4.2), so this profile deliberately carries no budget and the gate refuses to run against it.
desktop.role: the Office factory's native output (v2: ~1 MB / ~10k tris)

lod0.how: 256 px atlas (the v2 factory paints at 512 px/part) with the painted cards transcoded PNG->JPEG, decimation to the triangle budget, meshopt export (gltfpack -cc). As built by scripts/build_web.sh; shared vertex-colour materials remain an unused lever at this tier (LOD1 uses their flat-colour form instead).

lod1.how: second export from the same kit — one kit, two exports, never two models to sync. Clip set per SE-4.2 is walk/idle/talk-pose; the factory has no talk clip yet (SE-4.2's new-clip line is still open), so gather — the talking loop, retargeted from UAL Idle_Talking_Loop — stands in for talk-pose and is recorded as a stand-in, not as the talk clip.

lod2.how: standee + portrait pipeline built at M4.09 (scripts/build_standees.sh): the kit's master GLB (outputs-v2/, the export LOD0 derives from) is posed from its own clips and rendered in Blender/Workbench at the canonical 35-degree camera (512x512 masters, inverted-hull outline pass), composited and centre-cropped to 256x384, palette-quantised to lossless WebP. The gate unit is one pose sprite; the byte gate runs as scripts/validate_sheet.py --profile lod2 --gate (validate_glb.py parses GLBs only). Full record: factory STATUS, M4.09 entry.

source: plan/02-technical-plan.md §5.2 (weight budget and the avatar factory) + plan-to-complete/02-software-engineering.md SE-4.2 (factory web profile + weight gates). Byte budgets use 1 KB = 1024 bytes.
